runtimeDivergences.reason: Canonical Dev must have a distinct installed launcher/visible identity and must route its manifest-loaded runtime to WITCH_DEV_MAIN rather than silently executing Stable while appearing to be Dev.
acceptance: Tampermonkey name and Dock title both report WITCH DOCK - DEV v1.2.2.
Dev update/download URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
Every manifest-loaded runtime URL resolves to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
Dev bootstrap fails visibly rather than silently falling back to Stable if its expected core seam disappears.

notes: New Dev was created directly from the Stable baseline above.
Governance/documentation files on Dev are intentionally Dev-specific and are not runtime divergences.
Add a runtime divergence only when an open issue/task intentionally requires Dev behavior or module source to differ from Stable.
Channel routing may differ while unaffected module bytes remain Stable-equivalent.
